# My Editing and Proofreading Desk
> Human editing, proofreading, formatting, translation review, and document support for academic, business, author, application, and professional writing.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.editandproofread.com/): Overview of professional editing and proofreading services, secure upload, pricing, and editorial process.
- [Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/services): Compare proofreading, editing, academic proofreading, dissertation proofreading, manuscript editing, business proofreading, formatting, CV/resume editing, and translation review.
- [Pricing](https://www.editandproofread.com/pricing): Service rates, turnaround options, word-count based estimates, and custom review thresholds.
- [Submit Document](https://www.editandproofread.com/submit): Secure upload path for document review requests.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.editandproofread.com/editorial-policy): Human editing standards, academic integrity boundaries, confidentiality, and document handling policy.
- [Editors](https://www.editandproofread.com/editors): Editorial standards and expectations for human review.
- [Contact](https://www.editandproofread.com/contact): Support contact for custom quotes and unusual document requirements.

## Service pages
- [Professional Proofreading Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/proofreading-services): Final draft review for grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, and presentation.
- [Professional Editing Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/editing-services): Clarity, structure, tone, flow, grammar, and readability improvements.
- [Academic Proofreading Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/academic-proofreading): Final academic language review for essays, theses, dissertations, papers, and journal manuscripts.
- [Dissertation Proofreading Service](https://www.editandproofread.com/dissertation-proofreading): Grammar, references, formatting, tables, figures, and academic presentation checks for dissertations.
- [Thesis Editing Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/thesis-editing): Structure, scholarly tone, argument flow, sentence clarity, and consistency support for theses.
- [Manuscript Editing Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/manuscript-editing): Long-form editing for books, journal papers, and substantial professional documents.
- [Business Proofreading Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/business-proofreading): Client-ready review for reports, proposals, website copy, presentations, emails, and company documents.
- [CV and Resume Editing Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/cv-resume-editing): Editing for CVs, resumes, cover letters, LinkedIn summaries, and job application documents.
- [Document Formatting Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/document-formatting): Formatting support for headings, references, spacing, tables, captions, and submission-ready files.
- [Translation Review and Editing Services](https://www.editandproofread.com/translation-review): Human review of translated English for grammar, tone, terminology, clarity, and natural phrasing.
